subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers retire this broad field-report issue after splitting the remaining slices into owner-scoped issues, or keep it open as the umbrella tracker?
rationale: The issue spans config recovery, Discord/channel delivery, cron ergonomics, web search, setup auth, resource policy, and update process behavior; current main only proves partial fixes, so deciding whether the umbrella remains useful is a maintainer workflow and product-scope choice.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792 as the strongest active trackers, then close this issue after links are complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad field-report tracker until every historical slice is fixed, rejected, or separately tracked, accepting that it remains hard to validate automatically.

options.title: Close as superseded now
options.body: Close this issue now with links to the active canonical issues, accepting that weaker slices may require fresh focused reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85695 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55792 as the strongest active trackers, then close this issue after links are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is cross-surface product routing and issue hygiene rather than a single code owner fix, and this person has the strongest observed routing context for config, docs, and channel policy.
